options.text: FIND SOME RUSTED SCISSORS: pull the old scissors out of the tire in front of the car.
options.outcome: A pair of rusted scissors is stuck in a tire in front of the car. {{Kara}} pulls them out and kneels at the car’s side mirror.

options.text: FIND BURNT ANDROID: look behind the dumpster by the back wall.
options.fact: Behind a dumpster in the parking lot lies an android that was burned to death, an AX420 by the number on its uniform; above it someone has sprayed “DEATH TO ANDROIDS”.
options.outcome: Behind the dumpster lies an android that has been burned to death; the number on its uniform reads AX420. Sprayed on the wall above it: “DEATH TO ANDROIDS”.

options.text: READ “CYBER-WILDLIFE”: the magazine lying in front of the car.
options.fact: {{Detroit}} Today, “Cyber-Wildlife”: {{CyberLife}} is about to open the first android zoo, in Los Angeles, showing animals that have become extinct in the last thirty years (turtles, polar bears, mountain gorillas, African elephants and several species of tiger), which it promises will be “more real than the real thing”. options.text: READ “ANDROID AND {{CANADA}}”: the other side of it.
options.fact: A travel advertisement for {{Canada}}: “where the air is clean and the welcome is always warm.” Although the United States voted in its Android Act in 2028, the parliament there has again put off deciding whether to permit androids: they are not sold there and have no official status, while in the United States they fuel record growth and record unemployment.
options.outcome: {{Kara}} reads the advertisement: across the border, androids are still not allowed.

options.text: TRY TO OPEN CAR TRUNK: see what is in the back of the car.
options.outcome: {{Kara}} tries the trunk. It is jammed and will not open; she needs something to force it.

options.text: FIND A CROWBAR: look for something to force the trunk with.
options.outcome: A crowbar lies on the other side of the car, near the fence that borders the abandoned house next door. {{Kara}} picks it up.

options.text: FIND SOME CLOTHES: force the trunk open with the crowbar and put on what is inside.
options.fact: You found clothes in the trunk of the abandoned car and changed out of your android uniform.
options.outcome: The trunk gives. Inside are some old clothes, a jacket among them. {{Kara}} takes off her android uniform and puts them on.

options.text: CHECK NEIGHBORHOOD: look out through the gate you came in by.
options.fact: Police are patrolling the street outside the parking lot; you need to reach the train station without being noticed.
options.outcome: {{Kara}} looks out through the gate. There are police in the street. {{Kara}}: “The police are on our trail… We need to reach the train station without being noticed.”

adaptationNote: The chart’s group SNEAK PAST POLICE FORCES / SPOTTED BY POLICE. In the game it is a stealth sequence, not a menu; the string table lists its steps (avoid the cops in front of the squat and the motel, cross to the coffee shop, hide near the laundromat, cross to the bank, hide using an umbrella, hide in the pawn shop), and PowerPyx gives the route (motel side, bus shelter, “cross the street fast.
